Hi Anna — quick reply and we'll follow up with a short matrix and a one-pager. (attachment: residency-matrix-v2.xlsx)

Short answers up front:
- Residency: For hosted Marketplace listings we do region-local storage for customer content and inference artifacts by default — requests routed to the customer's selected region (AWS/GCP/Azure). Cross-region backups are not enabled by default for Marketplace listings; we only replicate cross-region when a customer explicitly opts into multi-region HA.
- Retention: Default logs + prompt artifacts are retained 90 days. KV cache is ephemeral and kept for up to 24 hours by default (session-bound). Customers can request 30/7/0 day retention profiles; for anything below 30 days we require an API flag and a signed Data Processing Addendum (DPA).
- Deletion: Standard portal deletion triggers a workflow that removes customer objects from primary storage within 48 hours and from backups within 30 days (backup snapshots are explicitly pruned). We can provide deletion manifests for enterprise customers after the 30-day prune completes.
- Private/VPC: For Private listings (customer-managed VPC or on-prem), Redwood does not keep a separate Marketplace copy of customer data. Marketplace metadata (listing status, billing pointer) is retained but not customer payloads.

Next steps: Vanessa will paste a short, marketplace-friendly blurb and the matrix for public listing copy. Marissa can confirm the DPA and legal wording. If you want, let's schedule a 30-min call with Cumulus legal + engineering tomorrow.

Thanks,

Hi Anna — pasted below is the marketplace-ready Q&A and the retention/residency matrix (see attached). I'll also drop a PDF to the Drive link. (attachment: Cumulus-Redwood-FAQ.pdf)

Marketplace Q&A (short bullets for listing/legal):
- Data locality: Customer workloads for Marketplace listings are pinned to the selected cloud region (AWS/GCP/Azure). All customer content and inference artifacts are provisioned in the selected provider region.
- Cross-region backups: Backups are disabled by default for Marketplace listings. If a customer opts into multi-region HA we replicate to the secondary region(s) indicated; this is an explicit opt-in during provisioning.
- Backup retention: Snapshots that include customer data are retained for a configurable window, default 30 days. Objects deleted from primary storage are removed from the next scheduled snapshot cycle; recovery from backup is possible until the snapshot prune (default 30 days).
- Deletion workflow: Portal/API deletion starts automated object removal from primary storage within 48 hours. Backup pruning occurs on a 30-day cycle; enterprise customers can request a manifest after prune which includes the object ids and timestamps. We are evaluating an automated signed manifest API for Q4.
- VPC/Private listings: No customer payloads are copied to Redwood-hosted storage. Listing metadata (billing/status) is retained for operations and invoicing only.
- Region switches: If a customer migrates regions, we create a migration job that copies the active objects to the new region and then triggers deletion in the source region. Customers are advised to schedule a migration window; we enforce a 72-hour waiting period before final prune to allow rollback.

Please find the residency/retention matrix in the attached spreadsheet and I've uploaded a PDF summary to the drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-residency-matrix

Let us know if that covers Legal's ask or if you need exact DPA language — Marissa is looping on contract wording.
